text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
While "shining ones" exist in great 
numbers—

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
"...Even among all of them, I still feel 
our generation is something special."

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
The me of another world had plenty of 
races where I couldn't quite seal the win, 
as you already know. But—

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
I ran in the Kikuka Sho where Fukukitaru 
showed off her explosive kick, and came in 
second at the Tenno Sho (Spring) where 
Bright fulfilled her long-cherished wish.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Racing with them, their brilliance—it 
elevated the other me's qualities and 
worth as a stayer—

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
—And then, following that came the 
Takarazuka Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
"...And there stood Suzuka, boasting 
overwhelming strength and having reached 
the aurora."

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
The me from another world finished 2nd 
behind Suzuka. ...Due to various 
circumstances, I never competed against 
Suzuka again after that, but—

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Taking second place here will certainly 
have an impact on her standing at medium 
distance... there's no doubt about that.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
"...'Even if you can't win it all, you are 
by no means weak.'"

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Having people support the me of another 
world like that... was partly because my 
peers shone a light on me, too.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
...However, this is my journey. This is 
our "Takarazuka Kinen."

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
We can't just stand here being 
illuminated, can we?
choice_data_list:
This time, I'll prove my strength for 
myself...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: —...Phew.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Seems you're not overwhelmed, Dober.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"...This is the first time I'm competing 
in a GⅠ against Bright and the Classic 
Triple Crown contenders, but—"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I have no intention of losing to 
anyone...! I'll show them what Mejiro 
Dober can do...!
(WOOOOOOOOOOOOOOAAAHH!!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: "—They're strong. Are you prepared?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Yes!!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: —...I intend to go.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Toward the view I couldn't reach at last 
year's Tenno Sho (Autumn)—

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Stronger than back then. Faster.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: What a coincidence, Suzuka.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
I'm trying to go there too. To the place I 
couldn't reach back then. That's why—

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
"It's on. You'll be staying by my side 
till the very end this time, too."

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Bring it on...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, whoa, whoa~! That's enough, both of 
you!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Don't you go forgetting about us! The bond 
between us Happy Come classmates is still 
going strong, after all!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Since this is our first gathering since 
the Derby~, I am quite fired up as well~.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Haha, I haven't forgotten at all! Of 
course I plan to compete against all of 
you too.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
—That's right. Not a single one of us is 
missing today.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
"That's precisely why it's fascinating. 
That's precisely why there's something to 
prove...!"

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Let's begin. This is————our "Takarazuka 
Kinen."
